_about: Cancelled prints only. Gentle: the target is the print, never the operator.
_license: Original to Print Handy; MIT with the project.
entries: You pulled the plug on {title}, a mercy decision historians will call correct.
{title} was cancelled at {duration}, the print equivalent of leaving the party early.
Cancelling {title} saved {grams} grams of {material} from a fate they did not deserve.
{title} got voted off the print bed, and the tribe of one has spoken.
You looked at {title}, checked the clock, and chose peace, which is respectable.
{printer} thanks you for ending {title} before things got truly embarrassing for everyone.
{title} was not cancelled, it was released from its obligations ahead of schedule.
The stop button was pressed on {title}, and honestly it never saw it coming.
{title} in {color} had a good run, right up until you regained your senses.
Stopping {title} early was not quitting; it was editing with extreme prejudice.
You gave {title} a full {duration} to impress you, generous bordering on charitable.
{title} has been cancelled by popular demand, where the demand was entirely yours.
Some prints finish, but {title} got an early retirement package and a firm handshake.
The wisest move in printing is knowing when to stop, and {title} thanks you.
You cancelled {title} before the spaghetti phase, a decision aged in wisdom.
{material} everywhere sends its thanks: {title} will not be wasting any more of it.
{title} was going places, mostly wrong ones, so the cancellation was a public service.
Ending {title} took courage, a steady hand, and one very final button press.
{title} joins the honorable ranks of prints stopped while dignity was still available.
You did not fail {title}; you simply declined to let it finish failing.
